comments.author: @shawnchauds
comments.text:
Visiting as a tourist and gawking at the spotlessly clean roads and flawless infrastructure is one thing,  Kudos to them for that. You have to give them credit for where it's due.

Living there, especially as certain ethnic minorities is a very different proposition.
Of course, it's all ok, if you are of European descent, in which case you'll be treated as a god over there. Glad I left as I hear from my friends still living there that the racism against minorities has become much worse now. 

This by no means takes away the fact that they have remarkably transformed themselves over the decades with world class infrastructure and diverse cuisine. 
It is just the people that spoil it for some and until they become more open minded and accepting of non-Western outsiders, I shall never be going back, even as a tourist.
